jobs.description:
Vi søger dygtig og engageret Smed/Svejser

Vi søger stabil, ansvarsbevidst og kvalitetsbevidst medarbejder til vores team.

Du vil blive en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, sikkerhed, samarbejde og godt håndværk.

Arbejdsopgaver

• 
Svejsning af metal- og stålkonstruktioner.

• 
MIG/MAG- og TIG-svejsning efter behov.

• 
Samling, tilpasning og bearbejdning af metalemner.

• 
Læsning og forståelse af tekniske tegninger.

• 
Slibning, skæring og klargøring af materialer.

• 
Kvalitetskontrol af svejsearbejde.

• 
Vedligeholdelse af værktøj og svejseudstyr.

• 
Andre relevante smede- og produktionsopgaver.

Kvalifikationer

• 
Du har erfaring med svejsning eller relevant uddannelse som smed/svejser.

• 
Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og samarbejde med kolleger.

• 
Du er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst.

• 
Du har forståelse for arbejdssikkerhed.

• 
Du er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst.

Vi tilbyder

• 
Fuldtidsansættelse

• 
Et godt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger.

• 
Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling.

• 
En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet og sikkerhed.

We Are Hiring – Skilled and Dedicated Metalworker/Welder

We are looking for a reliable, responsible, and quality-conscious worker to join our team.

You will become part of a workplace where we place great emphasis on quality, safety, teamwork, and skilled craftsmanship.

Job Responsibilities

• 
Welding metal and steel structures.

• 
MIG/MAG and TIG welding as required.

• 
Assembling, fitting, and processing metal components.

• 
Reading and understanding technical drawings.

• 
Grinding, cutting, and preparing materials.

• 
Performing quality control of welding work.

• 
Maintaining tools and welding equipment.

• 
Carrying out other relevant metalworking and production tasks.

Qualifications

• 
Experience in welding or relevant vocational training as a metalworker/welder.

• 
Ability to work independently and cooperate with colleagues.

• 
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality.

• 
Good understanding of workplace safety.

• 
Reliable, flexible, and responsible.

We Offer

• 
Full-time employment.

• 
A positive working environment with dedicated colleagues.

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• 
A workplace focused on quality and safety.

How to Apply

Please send your application to: contact@vieta.dk. Application Deadline: 1 December 2026

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we are driving the transition toward more sustainable and energy-efficient solutions. As our Global Inventory Manager (m/f/d), you will ensure the right products are available at the right time across our global network, balancing customer service, working capital, and operational efficiency.

Working within a global supply chain organization, you will take ownership of inventory strategy and performance across regions and sites. Through data-driven decision-making, process standardization, and cross-functional collaboration, you will help optimize inventory, support business growth, and strengthen supply chain performance.

As part of a business experiencing significant global expansion, you will have the opportunity to shape best practices, drive continuous improvement, and make a visible impact on our customers and our business.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and drive the global inventory strategy, performance management, and inventory optimization agenda across regions and sites.

• Monitor inventory performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement actions that balance service levels, inventory investment, and cost.

• Standardize inventory processes, develop data-driven reporting, and lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen global supply chain performance.

• Develop and enhance reporting tools and dashboards (Excel, Power BI) to support data-driven decision-making and inventory optimization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in inventory management within a multinational, multi-site manufacturing or supply chain environment.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive results in a global matrix organization.

• Strong analytical and business acumen, including the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights using tools such as Excel and Power BI.

• Experience working with S&OP/SIOP planning processes; knowledge of Integrated Business Planning (IBP) is an advantage.

• A proactive, structured, and self-driven approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing and evolving global environment.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Imagine working on Denmark's most critical systems, turning unique customer data into real value through applied machine learning. As our new Data Scientist, you will play a key role in analysing customer data and training models within our established product. Ready to make an impact?

The job

You will be responsible for generating value from customer data within our established product, which underpins national security and critical infrastructure domains. Our customers are classified and cannot be disclosed, so your work will take place in secure environments, often in collaboration with Product teams, security teams and onsite at customer locations. As this is a newly established position, you will have the opportunity to help shape this role as it grows.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Analysing and preparing customer data for use in our established product

• Training, evaluating and refining machine learning models on customer data

• Integrating models and data-driven features that generate measurable value

• Exploring customer data to identify new opportunities for value creation

• Collaborating with security teams to ensure compliance with national classifications and profiles

Joining the team

You will join an organisation where you will be associated with multiple teams, part of our NSI business unit. We develop and maintain military-grade solutions that support a nation's most critical systems. The organisation is highly collaborative, organised around Products that make a difference.

If you are located in Aarhus, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Copenhagen (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

We are looking for a data scientist with hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world data in production settings, who can work confidently in high-stakes, security-classified environments.

• Relevant technical education, Bachelor's or Master's, in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent experience

• Documented experience with applied machine learning on real-world data

• Some hands-on experience with data science and machine learning in production settings

• Strong knowledge of Python, machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), SQL and data processing tools

• Fluent Danish and English skills

• A strong security mindset and ability to work in high-stakes environments

Alongside this, we value:

• A collaborative and proactive work style

• Comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguity, particularly as this is a newly established role

• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities

• Comfortable working onsite at customer environments when needed

Expect travel activity to our HQ in Aarhus and to customer sites, primarily in Copenhagen.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations - you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Kasper Bach Klokker, Associate Director, NSI Operations.

**Help hospitals deploy, operate and get the most from UNEEG software solutions

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for an Application/IT Supporter who will be responsible for the technical deployment, support and ongoing operation of UNEEG's software solutions. You will help onboard new hospital customers, with a primary focus on the US market, while ensuring excellent service and operational continuity for our existing customers.

You will initially be part of Technology and later join the new Customer Enablement & Governance team. Working closely with the Project Lead, Customer Enablement & Governance, you will be the technical bridge between hospital IT teams and colleagues across Commercial, Clinical Operations and Technology. The role includes both remote and on-site support, and travel can be expected.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Plan, install, configure and test data transfer infrastructure solutions in hospitals

• Provide remote and on-site support for installations, upgrades, operation and troubleshooting

• Train hospital IT staff and system administrators to maintain deployed solutions effectively

• Monitor and maintain hospital servers, cloud clients and Microsoft Azure environments

• Troubleshoot networking, data communication, application and system performance issues

• Configure and manage virtual machines, containers and Kubernetes environments, and deploy patches and updates

• Document support cases and technical issues in Jira and collaborate with software developers on resolution and product improvements

• Maintain deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides and other technical documentation in line with healthcare IT and data security requirements

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Are service-minded, outgoing and persistent, and enjoy working directly with customers

• Take ownership, follow up rigorously and solve problems before they arise

• Can manage several tasks at the same time while staying structured and attentive to detail

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Enjoy collaborating across commercial, clinical and software development teams

• Are flexible when customer needs occasionally require support across time zones or outside normal working hours

**Your background:

**

• An education as an IT Support Technician or Data Technician, ideally focused on infrastructure, or a relevant degree in software development, infrastructure or a related field

• Experience or strong interest in customer-facing technical service or IT support; newly educated candidates with the right mindset are also encouraged to apply

• Proficiency in Microsoft Azure, virtualization and container-based environments, including Kubernetes

• Knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server, and scripting

• Ability to troubleshoot networking, application and system performance issues

• Experience with defect tracking and monitoring tools, such as Jira, Prometheus, Grafana or Azure Monitor

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• Healthcare IT, hospital environments or deployment in public-sector organizations

• Healthcare data standards, hospital IT security protocols or clinical trial workflows

• ITIL or similar service management methodologies

• Data protection and privacy requirements, including GDPR and HIPAA

• Supporting international customers in Europe or the US

• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Kubernetes Administrator

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

• A key role in supporting secure and scalable customer solutions in a growing medical device company

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international hospital stakeholders

• A workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture of togetherness

• A role based at our modern HQ in Allerød with good facilities and easy access

At UNEEG, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact Senior Director, Technology, Kim Heegaard Hansen at +45 25 65 75 01.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – Clean & Industrial Utilities
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager – Clean & Industrial Utilities

Location: Hillerød, Denmark

Department: DPM Expansion – Future QC

Are you ready to take ownership of a critical utilities workstream within one of Novo's largest quality control expansion projects?

Do you bring strong experience in clean or industrial utilities, combined with a practical understanding of commissioning, qualification and project delivery?

Are you motivated by the opportunity to influence a major Greenfield development, work with experienced engineering specialists and take responsibility for delivering complex technical systems?

If you enjoy combining technical knowledge with project leadership, stakeholder collaboration and practical problem solving, this could be an exciting next step in your career.

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager Clean & Industrial Utilities to join our DPM Expansion – Future QC programme in Hillerod, Denmark.

The position

As Senior Project Manager, you will take ownership of the commissioning and qualification planning and coordination for clean and industrial utility systems within our new Future QC facility.

The project represents an investment of approximately DKK 3 billion and involves the construction of a 42,000 m² quality control laboratory facility, the largest of its kind within Novo.

Working within a relatively lean and highly collaborative project organisation, you will have significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a direct impact on how critical utility systems are delivered, qualified and handed over to operations.

A central part of your role will be ensuring that commissioning and qualification activities are effectively planned, coordinated and aligned with construction milestones, equipment installation requirements and phased building handovers.

You will work closely with contractors, engineering specialists, validation colleagues, IT, equipment owners and other project stakeholders to manage technical dependencies, identify risks and ensure the successful progression of the utilities workstream.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

• Lead the planning and coordination of commissioning and qualification activities for clean and industrial utility systems.

• Work closely with the validation team to establish qualification strategies, timelines, vendor documentation requirements and appropriate levels of technical oversight.

• Work closely with the validation team to establish qualification strategies, timelines, vendor documentation requirements and appropriate levels of technical oversight.

• Coordinate with the main contractor, subcontractors and engineering specialists to ensure utility systems are delivered in accordance with project requirements and relevant standards.

• Manage interfaces and dependencies between utility availability, equipment installation, controlled shutdowns and phased building handovers.

• Review commissioning and qualification plans, identify potential technical or operational risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.

• Engage with equipment owners, IT, engineering and operational stakeholders to understand system requirements and ensure utility availability is aligned with their delivery schedules.

• Provide informed technical recommendations, support decision-making and escalate matters affecting cost, scope or programme timelines through established governance processes.

• Contribute to the successful handover of utility systems to the operational and maintenance organisations.

• Collaborate across the wider project team, supporting other critical workstreams where priorities and project needs require.

• This is a project manager position rather than a detailed engineering design role.

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you will bring a strong technical foundation in utility systems, practical experience in regulated operational environments and the ability to manage complex engineering activities.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have developed their careers through technical, maintenance, facilities or operational engineering roles before progressing into project management.

We Expect You To Have

• A relevant educational background in engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical industry experience.

• Strong technical experience in either clean utilities or industrial utilities, particularly piping related systems such as purified water, clean steam, heating, cooling, water distribution or compressed air.

• Demonstrable experience in equipment or systems commissioning, qualification and/or validation, including a sound understanding of controlled processes, documentation and operational requirements.

• Practical experience working within an operational plant, manufacturing facility or similarly complex technical environment, including exposure to maintenance activities, system start ups, shutdowns or equipment qualification.

• Proven experience coordinating engineering projects, technical workstreams, contractors or specialist service providers. Experience working within regulated or process driven industries where safety, quality, documentation and controlled operating procedures are essential.

• Strong planning, coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and technical dependencies.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken.

• Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology or other GMP regulated environments would be advantageous but is not essential.

• We also welcome relevant experience from industries such as food and beverage, chemical manufacturing, oil and gas, and engineering or EPC organisations, provided you bring the necessary utilities and qualification expertise.

• Experience across both clean and industrial utilities would be beneficial; however, strong expertise in either discipline is sufficient.

• Knowledge of Science and Risk-Based Validation (SRV), commissioning and qualification methodologies, and large-scale CAPEX or Greenfield projects would also be advantageous.

About The Department

• You will join the DPM Expansion Future QC programme in Hillerod, where we are delivering a major new quality control laboratory facility to support Novo's expanding manufacturing capabilities.

• The programme involves the development of approximately 42,000 m² of new laboratory and supporting infrastructure, representing a significant investment in the future of our quality control operations.

• The project is currently progressing through construction, with commissioning, qualification and phased handover activities forming critical elements of the delivery programme.

• Our engineering organisation is relatively lean, bringing together specialists across utilities, validation, engineering, technical interfaces and other essential project disciplines.

• This structure provides an opportunity for individuals to take genuine ownership of their responsibilities, work closely with experienced colleagues and influence important technical and operational decisions.

We value collaboration, practical problem solving and the willingness to take responsibility. While you will lead your own workstream, you will also be part of a team that supports one another and responds flexibly as project priorities evolve.

Joining us means contributing to a technically challenging Greenfield project where your experience, judgement and decisions will make a visible difference.

About You

• You are an experienced technical professional who combines a strong understanding of utility systems with the ability to plan, coordinate and deliver complex project activities.

• You understand what it takes to commission, qualify and operate technical systems in real world environments, and you appreciate the importance of controlled procedures, thorough planning and effective communication.

• You are comfortable working with experienced engineering specialists and contractors, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions constructively and bringing stakeholders together to find practical solutions.

• You take ownership of your responsibilities and are confident making recommendations, while recognising when issues require wider discussion or escalation.

• You are also adaptable and pragmatic.

• You understand that priorities can change within major construction programmes and are willing to support colleagues and other workstreams when needed.

• Above all, you enjoy being close to the technical and operational realities of a project and take pride in helping complex systems move successfully from construction through qualification and into operation.

Why Novo

At Novo, we don't wait for change. We drive it. Our commitment to defeating serious chronic diseases is built on more than a century of innovation, collaboration and a determination to make a meaningful difference to people's lives.

Joining our Future QC expansion programme offers the opportunity to contribute to a major investment in our manufacturing and quality control capabilities, while developing your experience within a global organisation undertaking complex engineering and expansion projects.

You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals, influence the delivery of a significant Greenfield development and contribute to infrastructure that will support our operations for years to come.

Working at Novo

Every day, we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a determination to innovate and a commitment to creating lasting change.

Working at Novo means joining a global healthcare company where talented people collaborate across disciplines, challenge established thinking and pursue solutions that can improve the lives of millions.

When you join us, you're not just starting a job you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

Salary And Benefits

The salary range for this position is DKK 742,600 to DKK 1,091,600 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Incentives And Benefits

Novo offers a competitive compensation package, including pension, bonus opportunities and a range of employee benefits designed to support your professional and personal wellbeing.

What We Offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce.

We offer an environment where you can develop professionally, take on meaningful challenges and build your career within a global organisation committed to innovation and long term progress.

Our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind, supporting your professional development, wellbeing and work-life balance.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we're not chasing quick fixes we're creating lasting change for long term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives.

This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to explore new possibilities, challenge conventions and push the boundaries of what is possible.

Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

We have an exciting opportunity for a seasoned Logistics Procurement Category Manager to join the Group Procurement function at Royal Unibrew.

Are you a passionate procurement and supply chain professional with expertise in Logistics and a demonstrated track record of positively influencing across internal and external ecosystems to unlock end to end value and efficiencies to fuel sustainable growth?

As Group Category Manager – Logistics, you will report to the CPO and lead the development and execution of the Group Logistics procurement strategy across road freight including line-haul and last mile distribution, ocean freight, warehousing and related logistics services including pallets. You will combine strategic category leadership with hands-on execution, working closely with local market organisations,

The role will be based at our HQ in Faxe, Denmark.

**Main Responsibilities

**Strategy Development:

• Define and execute a multi-year procurement category strategy for Logistics that balances local execution with strategic priorities to support the group’s overarching goals.

• Leverage a strong external radar and category expertise to identify, evaluate and act on emerging opportunities and risks, i.e. external supplier landscape, commodities, industry best practices, digitalisation and automation and EU legislative environment.

**Category And Supplier Relationship Management

**

• Optimise category management processes, elevate sourcing and contract management processes, and build best practices with the market teams and stakeholders. Increase utilisation of eSourcing and development of digital tools to support cost modelling, benchmarking, and contract management.

• Develop supplier collaboration platforms with key suppliers across the group to unlock operational efficiencies, process enhancements, digital innovation, and to accelerate sustainability and circularity initiatives.

**Value Delivery, Efficiency And Business Partnering

**

• Deliver cost savings, supply chain efficiencies and carbon reduction targets. Establish ways of working with stakeholders to measure relevant KPIs, track initiatives, manage risk and deliver multiyear productivity plans.

• Ensure early engagement and alignment with relevant stakeholders on business strategy to maintain a fit for purpose and efficient logistics network driving optimal cost to serve to fuel sustainable business growth.

• Provide category leadership and inputs into on strategic projects, integration, and network optimisation.

• Streamline processes and drive digitalisation agenda.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Bachelor’s degree. Professional CIPS qualification or similar will be considered.

• Min. 8 years of relevant procurement experience in logistics categories in an international or matrixed organisation. Nordics and CPG industry experience is a plus.

• Comprehensive knowledge of procurement processes, ERP systems, procurement tools and network modelling, including a strong data analytics skillset and commodity management experience.

• Excellent communication, gravitas and influencing skills to build relationships with senior stakeholders internally and externally.

• Team player with a service-oriented mindset but is also not afraid to challenge the status quo or be the critical friend when required.

• Project and change management - track record for initiating and embedding change.

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands on execution.

• Energised by challenges, white spaces, and complexity.

• Enthusiastic, solution-oriented approach.

• Passion for developing and coaching teams.

**What Success Looks Like

**Success in this role means creating a Logistics procurement organisation that is recognised as a strategic business partner, delivering measurable value beyond price reduction.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

With us, you'll be part of challenging the boundaries of sustainable production and distribution. You'll help ensure a diverse range of beverages that bring people together - on the dance floor, during the third half, or over a meal - all while contributing to strengthening Danish sports, music, and community life.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager, EndoIntelligence Solutions, Global R&D
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager with a background in medical device development? Do you enjoy leading complex development projects and coordinating work across internal teams and external development partners? Then you may be the Project Manager we are looking for in EndoIntelligence Solutions within Global R&D.

In this role, you will lead a strategically important development project and work closely with a global and cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Project Manager, you will:

• Lead a cross-functional development project through all phases of the product development process.

• Drive project planning, execution, follow-up, and reporting of scope, timeline, budget, risks, and key decisions.

• Coordinate activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders.

• Manage and maintain strong collaboration with external development partners and suppliers.

• Facilitate project governance activities, including Steering Committee reviews and decision-making forums.

• Ensure project documentation and deliverables are completed in accordance with Ambu's quality system and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Create transparency, alignment, and engagement across the project team and stakeholder landscape.

• Support the continuous improvement of project management practices and lessons learned.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the perfect candidate cannot be defined on paper. However, you are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a technical degree within engineering or a related field.

• Have experience leading the development of complex medical device hardware, including electronics, mechanics, embedded systems, and integration across disciplines.

• Have worked closely with external development partners and suppliers and understand how to manage outsourced development activities, technical deliverables, timelines, and risks.

• Have experience working with internal and external development teams across different regions, including Asian and European countries, and bring the cultural awareness needed to adapt ways of working and build effective collaboration across cultures.

• Are comfortable navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving alignment across functions.

• Bring a structured and proactive approach to project execution and risk management.

• Have strong communication and leadership skills and enjoy working with international teams.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**At Ambu, you will become part of an international organization with ambitious growth plans and a strong innovation agenda. We work in cross-functional teams and value collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while developing your professional and personal capabilities in a dynamic environment.

Apply directly through our job portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Ready to shape the marketing experience for one of the most exciting categories in Nordic e-commerce?

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to drive the customer-facing journey and category performance across our Kids department. From everyday essentials to seasonal collections, footwear and accessories, you will bring the category to life through engaging campaigns, inspiring content and a seamless shopping experience across our channels.

This is your chance to join a passionate, fast-paced team where creativity meets commercial strategy, and where your work makes a real impact on how customers discover and shop Kids at Boozt.

**What You Will Do

**As our Marketing Manager for the kids category, you will play a key role in planning and executing marketing activities across onsite, CRM and campaign touchpoints, ensuring that the category stays relevant, engaging and commercially strong.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Develop and execute quarterly and yearly Kids marketing plans, aligned with commercial priorities and seasonal initiatives.

• 
Own the Kids front page and key landing pages, ensuring a strong and engaging digital shopping experience.

• 
Monitor traffic, engagement and category KPIs, using performance insights to evaluate results and optimize activities.

• 
Coordinate with Buying & Merchandising (B&M) on trading plans, product launches and brand exposure.

• 
Collaborate with CRM to develop engaging, high-performing email campaigns that support category priorities.

• 
Brief and coordinate visuals with our Content and Art teams for campaigns and seasonal initiatives, ensuring a consistent experience across onsite, landing pages and newsletters.

**YOUR PROFILE

**We are looking for someone who combines a creative mindset with a strong commercial understanding and knows how to turn customer insights and category trends into engaging marketing activities.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
At least 3 years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably within fashion, kidswear or retail

• 
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines

• 
A collaborative mindset and experience working across creative, commercial and technical teams

• 
Strong analytical skills and experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Qlik Sense

• 
An understanding of customer behaviour, seasonal trends and what drives performance in an online retail environment

• 
Fluency in English, our company language

**WHY BOOZT?

jobs.occupation: Project Manager, Anaesthesia & Patient Monitoring Solutions
jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Project Manager to join our Patient Monitoring & Anaesthesia Solutions team in Global R&D.

Do you have experience in project management within the Medical Device industry and a strong technical background? Are you motivated by leading cross-functional teams and turning technical and business needs into successful product solutions?

As a Project Manager in our Patient Monitoring & Anaesthesia Solutions team within Global R&D, you will have the opportunity to lead a diverse portfolio of development projects, ranging from major new product development initiatives to focused projects that enhance, upgrade and extend the value of our successful existing products.

This variety is an important part of the role. You will be expected to adapt your project management approach to the scope and complexity of each project while maintaining a strong focus on quality, execution and business impact.

At our headquarters in Ballerup, where we develop many of our medical devices, we have a strong collaborative culture and a clear focus on bringing products to market based on a thorough understanding of customer needs. We develop, maintain products and production processes that combine multiple technologies in innovative ways. This requires strong project management capabilities, sound business and technical understanding, and broad experience with medical device development.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Leading medical device development projects of varying scope and complexity, from major new product development initiatives to product enhancements, upgrades and design changes, through to successful implementation at our production sites

• Establishing a motivating and collaborative working environment within global, cross-functional project teams

• Maintaining close collaboration with global stakeholders, particularly the Solution Steering Committee, to align resources, timelines, budgets and project strategies

• Setting clear project direction and ensuring effective planning and tracking of project progress, timelines and budgets

• Taking part in prototype builds, testing activities and interviews with users and stakeholders

• Contributing actively to the Solutions Team by sharing best practices, experiences and lessons learned across projects

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we recognise that the right candidate cannot be defined by a checklist alone. However, you are likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Hold a degree in engineering or a related technical field and have technical experience that enables you to support sound decision-making and address technical challenges throughout a project

• Have solid experience in Medical Device project management and bring a broad project management skill set and toolbox

• Are comfortable leading projects of different sizes and levels of complexity and can adapt your project management approach accordingly

• Have experience working with globally distributed project teams and suppliers

• Are curious, open-minded and possess strong interpersonal and collaboration skills

• Are committed and structured, with a strong sense of responsibility towards your work and your team

• Possess strong leadership skills and are able to create direction, engagement and momentum in cross-functional teams

• Have a certification in Project Management

• Are fluent in written and spoken English

**Apply

**Apply directly on our job portal, as we are not able to receive applications through e-mail.

The Talent Attraction team till engage with applicants on an ongoing basis, hence we encourage you to not hesitate, and apply today!

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**

**Are you motivated by working with complex commercial contracts, legal risk management and major construction and infrastructure projects in an international environment? Do you enjoy combining strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach to support decision-making and deliver practical solutions? And do you thrive in a collaborative role where you can build relationships across a global organization? Then COWI could be the right place for you.

**

To support our business in Denmark and internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our legal team at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby, Denmark. As an international consultancy, COWI delivers engineering, architecture, energy and environmental solutions across the globe. We contribute to some of the world's most significant and sustainable projects, and our legal team plays an important role in enabling our business, managing legal and commercial risks, and supporting successful project delivery.

In this role, you will report to the Head of Legal responsible for Business Line Denmark. You will join the Danish legal team, consisting of four senior legal counsels and two paralegals, and become part of COWI's Group Legal function. Group Legal comprises 25 team members based in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, the UK, Ireland and Canada, providing comprehensive legal support across COWI's business lines.

This position is ideal for an experienced legal professional who enjoys working hands-on with complex contractual matters, negotiating commercial agreements and supporting large construction and infrastructure projects. You will take ownership of legal matters, provide clear and commercially focused advice, and work closely with colleagues across the organization to manage risk and find practical solutions.

Your key responsibilities

• Providing day-to-day legal advice and assistance to senior management, operational management and project managers in Denmark and internationally.

• Structuring, drafting and negotiating consultancy agreements, framework agreements, joint venture agreements, memoranda of understanding, teaming agreements and other commercial contracts.

• Advising on contract management, claims management and the identification, assessment and mitigation of legal and commercial risks.

• Reviewing and negotiating contracts for large and complex construction and infrastructure projects, including agreements based on ABR 18, AB 18, FIDIC and bespoke contractual terms.

• Providing legal support to ongoing projects throughout their lifecycle, helping project teams navigate contractual obligations, risks and commercial challenges.

• Advising on disputes and settlement negotiations, including instructing and coordinating external legal counsel.

• Supporting, training and guiding line managers and senior management on legal matters, including contracts, public procurement, competition law, intellectual property rights and data protection.

• Supporting corporate housekeeping and advising on legal compliance matters.

• Providing legal support for mergers and acquisitions and other strategic business initiatives.

• Contributing to the continuous improvement and development of COWI's standard contract templates and legal processes.

**Your skills. Our teams. Together we design the future.

**

At COWI, collaboration is essential. We value professionals who build strong relationships, take ownership, and contribute with both technical expertise and a pragmatic, business-oriented mindset. You are proactive, curious and motivated to continuously improve how legal support is delivered across the organization.

On top of that, you will have:

• A Danish Master's degree in Law.

• Experience from a law firm and/or an in-house legal function.

• Extensive experience in contractual review and negotiation, including ABR 18, AB 18, FIDIC and bespoke forms of agreements.

• A strong understanding of legal and commercial risk management, with the ability to identify, assess and mitigate contractual risks.

• Strong drafting and communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Excellent analytical skills and the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, concise and commercially relevant advice for legal and non-legal stakeholders.

• A pragmatic, business-oriented approach, balancing attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of complex legal matters and make sound, well-reasoned decisions.

• A collaborative mindset and an interest in working as part of a specialist legal team supporting a large international organization.

• Experience working in an international environment would be an advantage.

**A place to work and so much more.

**

At COWI, we collaborate with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow.

We support our customers' transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to set a positive standard by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the solutions we provide for our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun, because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we bring together expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and the environment to create lasting impact.

**Got More Questions?

**

If you have any questions about the role or what we have to offer, please contact Head of Legal Denmark, Kit Bækgaard at kich@cowi.com or Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you're interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths.

We take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**Façade Engineer (Buildings and Industry)

**

**Aalborg, Aarhus, Esbjerg, Lyngby, Odense, Vejle

**

**Full-time

**

**Hybrid

**

**Do you want to bring your skills into play on innovative and multidisciplinary projects? Can you contribute to the development of the facade engineering market area? And are you motivated by building relations with colleagues, collaborators, and stakeholders? Then, this is your chance to become part of our skilled facade engineering group and contribute to the buildings of the future!

**

**Contribute to the development of façade engineering

**

The world seeks beautiful and sustainable solutions. To support customers in transforming their aspirations into realities, we are looking for a Façade Engineer to join our team of Façade Specialists. We have a good number of colleagues working alongside our customers on some of Denmark’s most significant projects in construction, such as the Water Culture House on Papirøen and the expansion of Terminal 3 at Copenhagen Airport.

Your main activity will be to participate in project design and supervision within Façade Engineering.

Other key activities will be:

• Identify the need for developing guidelines/procedures/best practices etc.

• Contribute to defining strategies for building relations with collaborators and stakeholders

• Develop external relations with customers

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in Structural Engineering or related field relevant to façade engineering

• At least 3 years of experience in façade engineering of building structures

• Communication skills in one of the Scandinavian languages and proficiency in English.

**A place to work and so much more

**

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. That is why we say no to fossil-based projects and aspire to have 100% of our revenue come from activities that move our customers towards sustainability.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 8,000 people who bring their knowledge in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**What we also offer

**

In this role, you will enjoy a rewarding job with significant freedom in a lively, international work environment, including:

• Collaborative opportunities with talented colleagues

• Attractive employment conditions

• Salary in line with industry standards based on your qualifications

• An enriching cultural experience

**Got more questions?

**

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to our Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, Priyanka, at prki@cowi.com.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**

We ask that you include your CV along with a cover letter in your application. At the interview, you’ll have the opportunity to share more about your interest in joining COWI.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Join Bureau Veritas Denmark in an exciting position as full-time administrative assistant in the Marine Dept.

**Join an industry leader!

**At Bureau Veritas Denmark you will become part of an interesting and international marine environment, where independence is valued and opportunities for personal and professional development and growth are provided.

Your overall focus will be on administrative tasks in our Administrative Department and Customer Support Centre in Copenhagen.

About the job

In our Administrative Department you will be assisting with the end-to-end invoicing process for completed marine surveys and inspections, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional communication with customers, surveyors, and internal stakeholders. At GomSpace, data is a critical enabler of everything we do, from developing advanced satellite solutions to running a global business serving customers around the world. We are looking for a hands-on Business Intelligence Specialist who can transform complex data into actionable insights and help build the foundation for data-driven decision-making across the organization.

In this role, you will play a key part in our digital transformation journey, enabling colleagues across Finance, Operations, Engineering, Commercial and Corporate functions to work smarter through trusted data, automation and modern analytics. If you thrive on solving complex challenges and want to influence how a leading space company leverages data to drive growth and innovation, we would love to hear from you.

Your Role

As Business Intelligence Specialist, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining GomSpace's integration and data platform landscape.

You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to ensure reliable integrations, high-quality data, and scalable analytics capabilities that support business operations and decision-making.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design, develop, and maintain the company's data integration architecture.

• Build and support integrations between systems such as IFS, Pipedrive, Jira, HR systems, QMS, ISMS, and other business applications.

• Establish and maintain a scalable data platform using Microsoft Fabric, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, APIs, and related technologies.

• Ensure data quality, consistency, governance, and traceability across all integrated systems.

• Monitor data flows and proactively solve data issues.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Establish strong working relationships with key stakeholders across Finance, HR, Operations, Quality, Sales, and IT.

• Achieve positive stakeholder feedback (>80% satisfaction) on responsiveness, communication, and support.

• Become the trusted owner of GomSpace's integration and data-platform roadmap and governance model.

• Establish the foundation of the Microsoft Fabric data platform, including governance, architecture, and core data model.

• Successfully implement and stabilize integrations between key business systems (IFS, Pipedrive, Jira, HR, QMS, ISMS).

• Achieve >95% successful automated data transfer rate across integrated business-critical systems.

Over time, you will:

• Be recognized as the go-to expert for business data, integrations, and analytics across GomSpace.

• Drive a culture of data-driven decision making across departments.

• Successfully align and prioritize BI initiatives with business strategy and operational objectives.

• Reduce manual reporting and data handling effort by at least 50% through automation and standardized data pipelines.

• Ensure >99% availability of critical integrations and data services.

• Deliver a scalable enterprise data platform supporting all major business functions with governed, trusted, and traceable data.

What You Bring

You are an experienced Business Intelligence specialist with a strong understanding of integrations, data platforms, and enterprise applications. You are motivated by building scalable solutions that enable trusted data and better business decisions.

You likely:

About Photoncycle

Solar panels make plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that for households. We store energy from the summer sun, so that the it can be used all winter. When there’s excess energy, we sell the surplus to the grid, where it helps balance supply and demand. Households pay a fixed monthly fee; we build, install and operate the system.

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems enable households to use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy.

Our customers are central to that mission. Every home we power is proof that energy independence is possible, and the stories of those homeowners are one of our strongest tools for reaching the next ones.

We are a team of 25 employees across offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026, we raised a €15 million Series A backed by NordicNinja, Voima Ventures, Lifeline Ventures, Eviny Ventures, Luminar Ventures and Momentum. We're now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, with the first phase of our production facility coming online in 2027.

The Role

We are looking for a Storyteller to own content creation and community management for our customers. Your main goal is to engage our customers with compelling, on-brand content, and to make Photoncycle something people want to follow, talk about and belong to.

You will shape how Photoncycle shows up on all communications channels, in both Danish and English. That means developing content concepts for social media, writing for our different platforms, and working with external photographers, videographers and agencies to bring ideas to life. You will also be the voice of our brand in our community channels, and you will create moments that bring customers, their neighbours, and future customers together.

Much of this is still unbuilt. Our Danish rollout is in its early phase, so you will spend a considerable amount of time testing formats, trying new ideas, and learning what resonates. We value creativity, curiosity, a structured way of working, and the ability to connect what you create to what the company and the customer actually need, not just the next post in the calendar.

You don't need to be an energy expert from day one. We will support you in learning about the energy markets, and there are experts to help you anytime.

You will join the the small Danish team that is building the market from the ground up, while also contributing to the global storytelling of Photoncycle. You will work closely with operations, product and our marketing colleagues in Oslo to turn a deep-tech product into stories people understand and remember.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and own the content strategy and content calendar across our channels, in Danish and English, tied to clear goals for engagement, awareness and customer loyalty.

• Shape the Photoncycle brand story, from our mission to the everyday lives of the homeowners who live with our system.

• Develop content concepts and recurring formats for social media that fit how each platform works.

• Write copy for our different platforms, including social media, newsletters, website, customer communication, and customer stories.

• Brief and manage external partners (photographers, videographers, agencies and freelancers) from concept to final delivery.

• Manage our customer community: engage, respond, moderate, spark conversations, and share customer insights with sales, service and product.

• Track performance, report on engagement and reach, and use the data to improve what we do.

What We're Looking For

Must-have experience

• Experience with concept development, content strategy and creation, brand storytelling or social media, in-house or at an agency.

• Excellent written Danish and strong written English.

• A solid understanding of the logic of social media platforms: algorithms, formats, and what drives reach and engagement.

• Strong project management skills: able to run several projects in parallel and deliver on time.

• Ability to explain complex or technical topics in plain, human language.

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the right answer isn't known yet.

Nice-to-have

• Experience working with external partners to produce content, such as video and images.

• Experience with community management or building online and offline communities.

• Background in energy, climate tech, home improvement, or other considered consumer purchases.

• Hands-on skills in short-form video, photo editing or design tools, for example CapCut, Adobe or Canva.

• Experience with social analytics, newsletter tools, CRM, or paid social.

We welcome applicants across experience levels, from motivated early-career storytellers to more senior profiles. If you bring a strong creative sense and genuine curiosity for this domain, we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every item above exactly.

What Success Looks Like

• Photoncycle has a recognisable, consistent brand voice that customers and prospects engage with.

• Our customers feel part of a community and share their experience with neighbours, friends and online.

• Content formats, partners and processes are in place so we can produce high-quality content at a steady pace, and scale it to new markets.

• The team makes better marketing and customer decisions by bringing engagement data and customer insight into the discussion, and you'll be part of making that happen.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to shape the voice of a high-impact climate technology company in one of its first markets.

• A central role in connecting Photoncycle's customers, product and brand.

• A collaborative, mission-driven culture with significant ownership.

• An office in the heart of Copenhagen at BLOXhub with lunch benefits and unlimited coffee.

Photoncycle is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Atomistic Stabilization in Solid Oxide Electrolysis Cells - DTU Physics
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about using atomistic simulations and machine learning to accelerate the green transition? Do you want to understand, atom by atom, why electrolysers degrade, and design materials that make them last longer? Do you have a background in computational chemistry, physics, materials science or chemical engineering?

Then this PhD opportunity at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) might be the perfect fit for you. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student for the project ATOMIZE: Atomistic Stabilization in Solid Oxide Electrolysis Cells, a collaboration between DTU Physics and Topsoe, funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark (DFF).

Solid Oxide Electrolysis Cells (SOEC) are among the most efficient technologies for producing green hydrogen, but their long-term stability remains a key challenge for large-scale deployment. In this PhD project, you will use density functional theory and state-of-the-art machine-learning interatomic potentials to study SOEC electrode materials at the atomic scale and at length scales that were previously out of reach. The aim is to understand what governs electrode stability and how it can be improved. You will validate your simulations against advanced experimental characterization data.

In practice, you will be hired at DTU Physics and join the Computational Catalysis group led by Associate Professor Alexander Bagger. The group has a long-term goal to develop predictive models and schemes for new reactions and materials in close connection with experiments. The group is part of the Catalysis Theory Center (CatTheory), which provides a strong infrastructure and computational facilities, including the Niflheim supercomputer with GPU nodes at DTU Physics.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The successful candidate must have an MSc in physics, chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science or related areas, as well as a strong interest in atomistic modelling and machine learning for sustainable energy solutions. The candidate must display good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, be innovative and able to work both independently and in cross-disciplinary teams, as well as with international academic collaborators and industrial partners.

Successful candidates must document:

• Experience with atomistic simulations & density functional theory (e.g. GPAW, VASP, ASE)
• Python programming skills
• Preferably, experience with machine-learning interatomic potentials (e.g. MACE, NequIP, or similar)
• Preferably, knowledge of solid oxide cells, oxide materials, electrochemistry or catalysis
• Preferably, experience with high-performance computing and Linux environments
Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
You will be assessed against the responsibilities and qualifications stated above and the following general criteria:

• Atomistic modelling and DFT experience
• Python programming experience
• Machine learning experience
• Knowledge of materials science, electrochemistry or catalysis
• Communication skills
We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is from 1 February 2027 or according to mutual agreement.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Alexander Bagger (alexbag@dtu.dk).

You can read more about DTU Physics at https://physics.dtu.dk/.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter, max 1 page)
• Curriculum vitae (max 2 pages)
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
